findings: Processed current NANPA-valid shard-C NPAs 260, 269, and 272 in numeric order after completed 203/206/209/212/215/218/224/227/239/248/251/254.

Retained 6 current public organizations: Food Not Bombs Fort Wayne; Forward Indiana; Kalamazoo Collective Housing; Care Collective of Southwest Michigan; Northeastern Pennsylvania Democratic Socialists of America; and Gather Community Space.

No organization in this bounded batch was retained as explicitly self-described anarchist. Food Not Bombs Fort Wayne is retained as anarchist-associated mutual aid; the remaining organizations are mutual-aid, cooperative, socialist, or community-adjacent without relabeling them anarchist.

Food Not Bombs Fort Wayne exposes public Instagram and Facebook links; Gather Community Space exposes public Facebook and Instagram surfaces. No directly public chat/server invite was confirmed in this bounded pass.
All six exact organization names returned no repository code-search matches before packet creation.
data.method: Authoritative NANPA membership gate; literal NPA searches plus locality-derived public-web searches; current-status verification; repository dedupe search; canonical StarIntel packet materialization.
data.research_question: Which current public anarchist, anarchist-associated, mutual-aid, and closely adjacent organizations are discoverable from the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs?
